issue.title: [A+] Shared-device multi-account nightly QA script
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Part of **A+ Ship-ready product**. Multi-account isolation must be proven on the **nightly** APK with a repeatable QA script (2+ accounts), not only unit tests.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Panel/session unit tests exist; shared-device matrix is ad hoc.

**Expected:** A short QA script (issue comment or `docs/guides/`) covering: add/switch accounts, no cross-account take leakage, settings/switcher usable, sync scoped to active user.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Author QA checklist/script
- Run once on nightly (or document blocker)
- File bugs for failures (do not silently waive)

**Out of scope**
- Implementing new account features
- Replacing #291

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Checklist checked into docs or linked from QA process
- [ ] At least one completed run recorded on this issue (pass or fail+bugs)
- [ ] Needs QA? path clear for future regressions

## Verification / test plan

1. Install nightly APK
2. Execute checklist with 2 accounts
3. Attach results / file follow-ups

## Links

- Related: #291, #348 (settings white screen on switch — may block)
- Docs: `docs/guides/qa-process.md`, `docs/guides/qa-preview-testing.md`
